independent_mathematical_topology: Six source dynamics conditions imply existing actual83 clock realization and each fixed-state bounded-test expectation continuity.
Conditional phase measure is normalized conditional Gibbs in position times standard Gaussian in momentum; xRef remains fixed and is not another factor in this outer measure.
Conditional Gibbs normalization requires finite positive mass, produced from existing integrability/probability APIs under source conditions; zero/infinite mass inverse normalization is insufficient.
Actual jointly measurable phase and continuous bounded test plus finite canonical Exp product yield jointly measurable test integrand and measurable state-indexed expectation.
Finite probability and global abs bound M yield |T_t f(z)|<=M for every state and finite time.
Actual83 gives pointwise fixed-state T_t f(z)->f(z) at ordinary nonpunctured NNReal0; no samplewise almost-sure convergence is needed.
Pointwise square error tends0; squared bound 4M^2 follows the expectation bound and |f|<=M.
Normalized outer phase probability makes constant4M^2 integrable; measurable squared errors plus pointwise limits plus domination AND yield outer squared integral->0 by DCT.
The scalar squared integral result is the bounded-continuous pointwise-test stage of source p6.2; C_b is an explicit ASTIS extension of source C_c.

This bounded-test conclusion does not establish all-L2 quotient operator well-definedness, invariant/Jensen contraction, density extension, semigroup, Markov, reversal, cost or main theorem. Those require independent open parents.
normalization_routes: An actual existing conditional Gibbs probability producer OR an independently proved finite-positive partition normalization route is sufficient; obligations inside either complete route are AND.
quantifier_boundary: Each fixed deterministic y,xRef and test/bound; same actual Z. No uniform parameter AE event, no correlated random-parameter substitution, no uniform convergence rate.
exceptional_cases: M0,rank0,infinite wait and exceptional uncovered samples retained through actual83; outer convergence follows deterministic statewise expectation limits. Ordinary NNReal0 includes time0.
